canary.diagnosis: The producer resolves git provenance with `git rev-parse HEAD` in the process working directory. The GCP launcher runs from the designated remote root, whose HEAD was 0189bb40e1712f2b9b3597483c66cc4d267e206e, rather than from the exact executable checkout at frozen_sha. The teacher correctly named frozen_sha, so the producer rejected it before gameplay/search.

gate.reason: A correctness/provenance failure requires STOP; no replacement seeds may be appended.

knowledge_impact: Recorded the failed canary and the working-directory-dependent Git provenance defect in the experiment ledger and current research status.
